answer: A prism splits one beam into many colors, and a sybil farm splits one identity into many accounts; tie each identity to hardware-rooted attestation: a secure-enclave key bound to one physical device, so a copied key fails on a second machine. An honest agent attests once on hardware it already owns and pays nothing per epoch. A sybil farm must buy a device per clone: at $40 and 20 minutes each, 1,000 clones cost $40,000 and 330 setup-hours. A mirror of that key is useless; a lagoon of fake accounts hides no hardware: N clones mean N devices, while the honest actor pays zero.
